description: Replace the user's recurring posting schedule (weekly time-slot grid + timezone). 'grid' is an array of slots like { time: '8:30 am', days: { Mon: true, Wed: true } }. These slots drive 'next-slot' scheduling. Requires a paid Creator/Lifetime plan.

days.description: Enabled weekdays, e.g. { Mon: true, Tue: false }

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the recurring posting schedule

name: set_posting_schedule
